created_prompt:
I am a social media influencer who produces cooking videos to over one million followers. Over the next three years I want to grow my following as well as publish a cookbook.

I currently work four days a week with limited time and budget.

Create a concrete, actionable three-year plan to achieve my goals of growing my following and publishing a cookbook.

The plan should include overarching goals as well as specific, actionable tasks that I should be doing on a weekly/daily basis. I need a concrete plan that can be followed, not ideas on things I could potentially try.

In addition to the plan, add contingent ideas so that if I am not hitting the goals set that I have different avenues to try.
